who_counts_as_adjudicator: reviewer class independent from authors and dataset curators
authorized to synthesize reviewer outputs under declared governance
bound by blinding and conflict policy
independence_requirements: no hidden access to blinded labels
no undeclared financial or reputational conflict
decision_authority_boundaries: adjudicator may classify admissible evidence pathways
adjudicator may issue pass/fail/inconclusive only after admissible evidence exists
adjudicator may not authorize metaphysical or identity-preservation claims
interpretation_boundary: Adjudicator criteria define later governance only. They do not constitute an adjudication decision.
